appraisal_events.evidence: Albertine semblait trouver qu'il y eût eu de sa part quelque grossièreté à croire que ce plaisir matériel allât sans un sentiment moral; elle disait qu'elle croyait que les baisers impliquent l'amour.
appraisal_events.explanation: Following the physical intimacy already established before the passage opens, the narrator dwells approvingly on Albertine's docile, tender, almost noble affection afterward, framing her warmth and lingering closeness as a positive continuation of realized intimacy rather than a new contest.

appraisal_events.evidence: Albertine... était une des incarnations de la petite paysanne française dont le modèle est en pierre à Saint-André-des-Champs. De Françoise... je reconnus en elle la courtoisie envers l'hôte et l'étranger, la décence, le respect de la couche.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator elevates Albertine by likening her to a venerable stone-carved archetype of French peasant courtesy and by crediting her with the same decency and hospitality he admires in Françoise.

status_effects.explanation: Albertine is shown as tender, willingly lingering, and affectionate after intimacy, continuing the narrator-endorsed warmth of the encounter rather than withdrawal or discomfort.
The narrator praises Albertine by association with a venerable rustic archetype of decency and courtesy, and by comparison to Françoise's own valued qualities.
